image_description: A close-up shot of a white ceramic plate on a wooden table. A spoon is suspended vertically above the plate, dripping thick, dark chocolate sauce onto a central mound of the same sauce. The sauce on the plate is arranged in a decorative pattern resembling a smiley face, with two dots for eyes and a curved line for a mouth. The sauce exhibits high gloss and viscosity.
